title: Python: drift watchdog timer (T_DRIFT_WARN)
description: Implement drift warning watchdog timer. Acceptance: Triggers at correct threshold.
close_reason: Implemented DriftWatchdog timer class with T_DRIFT_WARN_SUPERFRAMES=3 threshold per spec section 14.8. Watchdog triggers after >3 missed beacons (ticks without reset). Added 11 tests covering threshold behavior, reset, and CcpFSM integration. All 83 tests pass.
